member.param: This constant string is used as a "salt" value for the Rfc2898DeriveBytes function calls. This size of the IV (in bytes) must = (keysize / 8). Default keysize is 256, so the IV must be 32 bytes long. Using a 16 character string here gives us 32 bytes when converted to a byte array.
